title: Open Robotics RViz XYZPCTransformer PointField Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134051)
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Open Robotics RViz due to an out-of-bounds read in the XYZPCTransformer component when processing PointCloud2 messages. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to cause a crash without authentication. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of user-supplied data, leading to a read past the allocated memory boundary.
